messages:
acme-integration: Hey team, after we did the SCIM + SSO onboarding our app started getting 403s for embeddings and generation calls. Rerank still works but embeddings/generation return "403 permission denied". Can you help?
elaine-cs: hey — sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the exact error body and a repro curl?
acme-integration: Error snippet: `{"error":{"message":"insufficient_permissions","reason":"missing:inference,missing:embeddings"}}`
acme-integration: Repro: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 403
acme-integration: Token was provisioned via our IdP SCIM provisioning flow (we used the enterprise SSO setup).
idp-sync-bot: automated notice: SCIM sync completed for tenant acme-corp at 2025-09-02T14:22:10Z (provisioner v1.9.2)
elaine-cs: thanks. @samir-eng can you peek at the authz logs? Looks like claims are missing the inference/embeddings entitlements.
samir-eng: pulled the token audit for the provided token id XXX-RED. The id_token/claims payload coming from the provisioner is: ```{"sub":"svc:acme:bot","entitlements":"inference rerank"}``` — notice embeddings is missing.
acme-integration: but in our IdP the app is entitled to both generation and embeddings. The SCIM manifest shows `scopes": "inference,embeddings,rerank"`
tom-sre: can you paste the raw SCIM-to-service payload that the provisioner received? Wondering if there's a delimiter parsing issue.
acme-integration: we grabbed the webhook payload, here's the header and body (sanitized): ```Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
{ "user":"svc-acme", "scopes": "inference; embeddings; rerank" }``` — we saw semicolons in the payload because our SCIM CSV had semicolons as delimiters (legacy export).
samir-eng: Aha. The provisioner v1.9.2 canonicalizes on comma-separated scopes; it splits on `,` only. If scopes come in with `;` and have spaces, the regex in the parser does `split(',')` then `trim()` and due to a downstream normalization step it does `join(',')` and then the sanitizer truncates after encountering the first unexpected char in the downstream claim encoder. In short: "inference; embeddings; rerank" became "inference rerank" in the final entitlement claim. That explains why embeddings disappeared.
elaine-cs: timeline: customer SCIM export used semicolons -> provisioner didn't normalize -> final claim missing embeddings -> calls with that token 403 for embeddings/generation. Rerank happens to remain because we have a legacy fallback that maps the single scope `rerank` to the rerank entitlement.
acme-integration: ok that makes sense. How urgent is a fix? We have prod traffic failing.
samir-eng: short-term mitigation: create a manual API key from the Console (team settings -> service keys) and explicitly grant `embeddings` and `inference` scopes. That bypasses SCIM. Or update your SCIM export to use commas (`,`) and re-provision.
elaine-cs: I can generate a support key with embeddings+inference for 24h if you want — that will buy you time while we patch the provisioner.
acme-integration: please yes, that would be great. Also would like steps to repro so we can validate after we re-provision.
tom-sre: repro steps for our team: 1) export a CSV from IdP using `;` as delimiter with a scope cell like `inference; embeddings; rerank` 2) hit SCIM provisioner endpoint with that payload 3) look at `provisioner.log` entries for `normalized_scopes` and `claim_payload` 4) inspect resulting JWT `entitlements` claim in the token issuance logs: `kubectl logs provisioner | grep claim_payload` should show the mismatch. Example snippet we saw: ```provisioner: info normalized_scopes="inference rerank" claim_payload={..."entitlements":"inference rerank"}```
samir-eng: root cause: provisioner v1.9.2 only splits on commas. We'll release a hotfix to normalize `;` and whitespace around scopes, and add validation to reject ambiguous scope formats. Patch PR #4023 underway. ETA for deploy to prod: ~3 hours after QA.
elaine-cs: I'll raise an internal incident and flag priority p1 for customer-impacting. @acme-integration I'm generating a 24h support key now.
elaine-cs: (support key created) `svc-support-temp-ACME-24h` — it has inference, embeddings, rerank. Please rotate your app to use it and confirm.
acme-integration: switched to support key — generation + embeddings now succeed. Thank you. Can you confirm when the provisioner fix is rolled so we can re-provision via SCIM?
samir-eng: will post here once the hotfix is live and provide the commit/helm chart. Also adding a small validation script you can run locally to sanitize your CSV before re-provision. I'll attach it here in the thread.
elaine-cs: follow-ups: - support key expiry scheduled in 24h, we can extend if needed - we'll coordinate a maintenance window for the provisioner deploy and re-provisioning - I'll add a KB note for customers with legacy SCIM exports to use comma-separated scopes
acme-integration: appreciated, team. One ask: can we get a log line example to show our IdP team to change their export? They prefer to see the exact upstream payload.
tom-sre: paste this to IdP team: ```{ "user":"svc-acme", "scopes":"inference, embeddings, rerank" }``` and explain that semicolons cause the provisioner to mis-parse.
acme-integration: perfect. Closing for now, will re-open if anything else after you roll. :+1:
elaine-cs: Thanks — marking this thread resolved in our tracker, will reopen if any regression.
